title: Which Crystal Is Your Soulmate?
title_zh: 哪种水晶是你的灵魂伴侣?
description: Discover which crystal resonates with your energy and matches your soul
description_zh: 发现哪种水晶与你的能量产生共鸣，匹配你的灵魂

questions.text: How do you typically recharge your energy?
questions.text_zh: 你通常如何恢复你的能量?

questions.text: What do you seek most in life?
questions.text_zh: 你在生活中最追求什么?

questions.text: How do you handle emotional challenges?

options.text: I talk it out with someone
I work harder to overcome it
I take time to process alone

questions.text: Which vibe resonates with you most?
questions.text_zh: 哪种氛围与你最有共鸣?

questions.text: What quality do you value most in yourself?
questions.text_zh: 你最看重自己的什么品质?

rose_quartz.title: Rose Quartz
rose_quartz.description: You are a hopeless romantic with a heart full of love. Rose Quartz, the stone of unconditional love, is your soulmate crystal. It resonates with your nurturing nature and reminds you to love yourself as fiercely as you love others.
rose_quartz.description_zh: 你是一个充满爱心的浪漫主义者。玫瑰石英是无条件之爱的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它与你培育的本性产生共鸣，提醒你要像爱别人一样爱自己。

amethyst.title: Amethyst
amethyst.description: You are a soul seeker with a deep connection to the spiritual realm. Amethyst, the stone of wisdom and spiritual growth, is your soulmate crystal. It amplifies your intuition and guides you on your journey to inner peace.
amethyst.description_zh: 你是一个灵魂探索者，与精神领域有深厚的联系。紫水晶是智慧和精神成长的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它放大你的直觉，引导你走向内心平静。

citrine.title: Citrine
citrine.description: You are a go-getter with an infectious positive energy. Citrine, the stone of abundance and success, is your soulmate crystal. It attracts prosperity and empowers you to manifest your dreams into reality.
citrine.description_zh: 你是一个积极进取的人，拥有感染性的正能量。黄水晶是富足和成功的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它吸引繁荣，赋予你将梦想变为现实的力量。

clear_quartz.title: Clear Quartz
clear_quartz.description: You are a clear thinker with a powerful presence. Clear Quartz, the master healer, is your soulmate crystal. It amplifies energy and thought, helping you achieve clarity in all aspects of life.
clear_quartz.description_zh: 你是一个思路清晰、存在感强的人。白水晶是大师治愈者，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它放大能量和思想，帮助你在生活的各个方面获得清晰。

carnelian.title: Carnelian
carnelian.description: You are a passionate soul with unstoppable motivation. Carnelian, the stone of action and courage, is your soulmate crystal. It fuels your fire and helps you take bold steps toward your goals.
carnelian.description_zh: 你是一个充满热情、动力永不停歇的人。红玉髓是行动和勇气的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它点燃你的热情，帮助你大胆迈向目标。

moonstone.title: Moonstone
moonstone.description: You are a dreamy intuitive with a deep emotional landscape. Moonstone, the stone of feminine energy, is your soulmate crystal. It balances your emotions and connects you to the cyclical rhythms of life.
moonstone.description_zh: 你是一个富有梦想、直觉敏锐的人，有着深刻的情感世界。月光石是女性能量的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它平衡你的情感，连接你与生活的循环节奏。

sapphire.title: Sapphire
sapphire.description: You are a truth seeker with a sharp, analytical mind. Sapphire, the stone of wisdom and royalty, is your soulmate crystal. It brings mental clarity and attracts spiritual truth into your life.
sapphire.description_zh: 你是一个追求真理、思维敏锐的人。蓝宝石是智慧和王权的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它带来思维的清晰，吸引精神的真理进入你的生活。

pyrite.title: Pyrite
pyrite.description: You are a confident achiever with a magnetic presence. Pyrite, the stone of abundance and protection, is your soulmate crystal. It shields you from negativity while attracting wealth and success.
pyrite.description_zh: 你是一个自信、有吸引力的人。黄铁矿是富足和保护的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它保护你免受负面影响，同时吸引财富和成功。

emerald.title: Emerald
emerald.description: You are a compassionate leader who values loyalty and growth. Emerald, the stone of love and wisdom, is your soulmate crystal. It brings harmony to relationships and encourages personal transformation.
emerald.description_zh: 你是一个富有同情心的领导者，重视忠诚和成长。祖母绿是爱与智慧的宝石，是你的灵魂伴侣水晶。它为人际关系带来和谐，鼓励个人成长。
